notes: A132827_dispersion (A132827_mathlib.lean): the dispersion of f(n) = floor(n*phi + n + 1) (rows start at the increasing complement of the range of f, Nat.nth) equals (b(i)+1)F(2j) + (i-b(i))F(2j+1) with b(i) = 2i - floor(i*phi), for all i >= 0, j >= 1; nth_P: column 1 is floor(i*phi)+1 (Mathlib Rayleigh/Beatty theorem); A132827_data: the entry's 36 terms are this dispersion by antidiagonals. Side finding: the entry's FORMULA with b = A005206 is wrong for every row i >= 4 (entryFormula_wrong: 6 vs 7 at row 4, column 1); correct b(i) = i - floor(i/phi). Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: the 36 data terms are copied by hand; failure of the A005206 formula for rows i > 4 by a one-line inequality and certificate/check.py (i < 2000). The insertion definition via A132828 is ill-defined (entry says the program had an error) and is not treated.
